description: This file contains a function 'ansi2html' that converts ANSI escape sequences in text to HTML span elements with inline styles, along with related color mappings and helper functions.

methods.name: ansi2html
methods.description: Converts ANSI escape sequences in a string to HTML span elements with inline styles, applying color and text styles based on ANSI codes.

methods.name: escapeHTML
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: styleBody
methods.description: Converts a style object to a CSS style string.
